records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official Metropolitan Police Service Violence Against Women and Girls dashboard data. The offence-based resource VAWG_Offence_Data.xlsx covers January 2014 through April 2026 and its Location worksheet contains aggregated counts by BCU, borough and ward. The release is licensed under Open Government Licence v2 and updated monthly. This batch binds the already verified Campden ward code E05009390 to that unused official ward-level source window without claiming extracted ward rows, parcel geometry, spatial join or programme progress.
